initialEvidence.reviewScope: Retained independent local acceptance covers this initial source/artifact/assessment inventory. Subsequent factual publication metadata is not described as an already-reviewed commit.

source.sourceRetrieval: Fresh public filtered Git fetches verify pinned commits/trees and representative manifest blobs. Source content is reconstructed independently from the published19file overlay and canonical base; no development-worktree source is copied.

release.retentionPolicy: Fixed release/tag/asset identity; never overwrite. Verify hashes rather than assuming server-side immutable-release protection.

candidateArtifacts.verification: Every downloaded tarball size/SHA256, exact regular-file inventory, every payload SHA256 and packed package name/version match the published attestation.

sealedBaseline.verification: Published archive download/hash, complete file inventory/hashes, schemas, completion, source identity, population and every validator shard/totals passed.

numericalReplay.helper: reanalyze.py from the fresh published initial evidence checkout
numericalReplay.observations: observations.json.gz from the downloaded verified task asset

metadataScope: This follow-up binds native commit C, tested snapshot S, packed artifacts P and shared baseline B without inserting an evidence hash into C. Original observations, assessment, artifact bytes and accepted historical receipts remain unchanged.
remainingGates: Independent checkpoint A GitHub development review
Separate checkpoint B local release-readiness review and fresh GitHub review pair
Actual final-head external Azure REST API Specs integration success
limits: Input recovery and numerical replay are not a fresh native compiler/coverage rerun or a new semantic assessment.
Pinned filtered source retrieval is not a fully materialized source installation.
Exact candidate packages are retained; future external transitive dependency availability or deterministic resolution is not guaranteed.
Original long machine-specific logs remain local; this committed receipt exposes only sanitized technical outcomes.
Publication and local acceptance do not establish task completion or reviews of subsequent commits.
